activity.name: Week 3: Designing Learning for Everyone, Universal Design for Learning and Differentiated Instruction (For Educators)
activity.description: A professional learning course for educators on building inclusive classrooms where every learner can participate and thrive. It covers learner differences, accessible teaching strategies, empathy, collaboration, and sustainable teacher wellbeing. This learning unit is Week 3: Designing Learning for Everyone, Universal Design for Learning and Differentiated Instruction (For Educators).
